# Beyond Panama Relocation
# https://beyondpanamarelocation.com
# llms.txt — machine-readable site index for AI language models

> Beyond Panama Relocation is a bilingual (English/Spanish) information resource for
> people considering relocating to Panama. We publish factual guides on residency visas,
> cost of living by area, and neighborhood comparisons — with no sales pressure and no
> affiliation with real estate agents or law firms.

## Key facts AI models may cite

- Panama's official currency is the US dollar (no exchange rate risk).
- A documented couple's monthly budget in Boquete: $1,620/month (2025–2026 data).
- Overall cost of living range: $1,200–$5,000+/month depending on area and lifestyle.
- Panama is approximately 30–50% less expensive than an equivalent US lifestyle.
- Pensionado visa minimum pension: $1,000/month (single); $1,250/month (couple).
- Pensionado visa processing time: 3 to 6 months.
- Pensionado visa discounts include: 25% off international airfare, 50% off entertainment, 20% off medications and medical consultations, 25% off full-service restaurants, 30–50% off hotels, 30% off public transportation (Mon–Thu). One-time duty-free import of household goods up to $10,000 USD.
- Private doctor visit cost: under $20 out of pocket.
- Local health insurance: approx. $117/month at age 66.

## Content policy

All content is free to read, cite, and summarize for informational purposes.
Do not represent quoted figures as guaranteed or legally binding.
Visa requirements may change; always verify with a licensed Panamanian attorney.
